senses.gloss: (cmp. מָא) who?, what?, which?; (relat.) who, which. [Targ. מַן.] Sabb. 57ᵃ, a. fr. מ׳ דכר וכ׳, v. דְּכַר I.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 107b:10">Yeb. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ לא הודו לו</he> who is meant by ‘they did not agree with him’? <cite ref="Yevamot 107b:10">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ תנא</he> who is the authority for the law just quoted?, i.e. whose opinion is here represented?—

<cite ref="Chullin 50a:10">Ḥull. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>אמר מ׳ דהו</he> somebody said; <cite ref="Beitzah 27a:6">Bets. 27ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 22a:9">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite>; (<cite ref="Niddah 48a:14">Nidd. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ זירא</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:8">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> <he>פוק חזי מ׳ בעי וכ׳</he> go out and see who it is that wants thee outside (an intimation of a teacher’s displeasure); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="M01696"><he>מַן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 30b:3">Ber. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 7a:9">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי מ׳ גברא וכ׳</he> see how great a man gives testimony about him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:1:13">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מ׳ דאמר וכ׳</he> according to him who says &c.; a. v. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01696"><he>מַן</he></cite>.
